item.text:
Subject: Thanks for lending me your camera!

Hi Alex,

Thanks so much for lending me your camera last weekend! It was lovely to try it out, and I really appreciated you showing me how to use the different settings.

My favourite photo was of a golden sunset over the lake, with a little sailboat drifting across the water. I had such fun waiting for the light to hit just right. I’ll send you a copy!

I’d love to return the camera this week. Would Thursday evening work for you? I could drop it off at your place around six, or we could meet at our usual café if that’s easier. Just let me know what suits you.

Thanks again!
Sam
